title: HINGED OAK CUTLERY BOX OF VINT...

findings: Oak hinged cutlery box with blue felt lining and lift-out tray. Inset brass oval plaque engraved 'To Mrs Charles McFerran on the occasion of her marriage 15-11-24' (1924). condition: Box worn with general scuffs, lining intact; contents used and mixed.
reason: Presentation-dated 1924 oak box plus collectable paste and cut-steel buttons and buckles; button collectors pay for the better pieces.

findings: Six pieces of drip-glazed Australian art pottery: flared brown/green vase, orange ribbed bowl, green handled cup, blue/green waisted vase, curved green trough planter, plus one more small piece. reason: Unmarked Tasmanian and Australian drip-glaze pottery has a local collector market; worth checking in hand for incised marks.
